configuration.setup_timeout_note: Allow dependency installation up to 1800 seconds; this is separate from the unchanged native task-work and per-attempt verifier limits. Historical official pilot used the Harbor default of 360 seconds.
configuration.execution: Run the four disjoint budget groups sequentially through the standard harbor_adapter entry point. Together they form one predeclared 20-task cohort, one model run per task.
configuration.preflight: Install-only for all tasks before model work. Registered QEMU verifier dependencies must pass; other tasks explicitly report not_configured.
configuration.failure_policy: Preserve every trial. Report scored failures, setup failures, and verifier errors separately; never replace trials based on scores.

accounting_note: Known token-based estimates use the static price table shipped in v0.9.0. Incomplete attempts are excluded from known subtotals; their cost and tokens are unknown, not zero. These are not provider billing totals.
evidence_note: Raw trajectories, journals, setup logs, and verifier output remain in the referenced Git-ignored local jobs directories. This file contains metadata and aggregate metrics only.

failure_observations.model-extraction-relu-logits: The agent ended with `response_truncated` after about 300 seconds. The official test failed because `/app/steal.py` was missing, so the required `/app/stolen_A1.npy` artifact was not produced. This is a scored failure, not a setup or verifier error.
failure_observations.schemelike-metacircular-eval: The agent ended with `response_truncated` after about 1,162 seconds. The official evaluator passed 58 of 63 subcases and failed 5, producing reward 0. Two earlier model streams raised `RemoteProtocolError` and were retried successfully; their usage was unavailable. The verifier itself completed on its first attempt. The terminal outcome and incorrect subcases are separate observations, not proof that truncation caused every incorrect result.
